items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I knew Godfrey, man... I followed Godfrey on a different job.

ctx.x: And the piano player, I can't see at all. The piano player is Dominic Baraka. Oh, Dominic Baraka. What happened to Andy Hardy? He played the hornbow. Did you play with him? No, I wouldn't play with him. What did he play like? He played kind of like Lewis.
